description: Multi-turn merge of the old #11 (injury-event-array) and #40 (injury-event-real-id-among-several), split across real turns instead of one crammed message - a realistic check-in disambiguates an existing flag by body part, then separately discloses something new. Turn 2 is #40's real test: three similarly-named flags in context, the athlete names one by body part, injury_event must reference the exact matching flag_id, not an invented or sibling one. Turn 3 is #11's real test: a genuinely new injury in the same check-in must not get silently dropped. Correction from the old #11: it predates #693's injury_flag/injury_event split (injury_flag = brand-new, no id yet; injury_event = update/resolve of an existing flag_id) - #11's ankle tweak had never been flagged before, so under today's schema that's injury_flag, not the injury_event it originally asserted. Turn 3 here asserts the corrected field.
